items.text: Fixed Cloud Save sync on Steam Deck
Added Steam Deck support

New notebook notification system: This is the most requested feature from you, guys, so we are delighted to implement this in the Director's Cluck update. You can now see how much new info you have in each category, and we highlight every specific one individually to find them easily.
New function = Detective eye: You have a new icon in the bottom left corner of the screen. If you press this icon, every interactive element will be highlighted on your screen!

notes.title: SMALLER FEATURES / QUALITY OF LIFE CHANGES

items.text: If you press the "skip dialog" button the first time, you'll get a warning instead of instant skipping the dialogue instantly. (this occurs just once in a playthrough!)
We have new and convenient popup tutorial messages if you look at your inventory or your notebook for the first time. (this also occurs just once in a playthrough!)
You'll get a warning message every time you click or press a button while a cutscene is playing, preventing accidental cutscene skipping.
You can now change categories in the notebook simply by turning pages.
We have a new gradient-black background behind our platform-specific elements to improve readability while playing with a controller.
We tweaked the left and right scrolling threshold heavily to prevent accidental scrolling while you want to press or click on a button in the corner of the screen.
You don't get Ibn's 7th personal info early anymore (which caused some spoilers and confusion).
Fixed some Japanese typo issues and minor translation mistakes.
We fixed plenty of English typos and mistakes.
The jukebox now doesn't play songs that you haven’t discovered yet.
Car chase minigame is way smoother (and somewhat easier) now.
We updated the zipper animation and controls in the zipper minigame for a smoother zipping experience.
We added some UI refinements regarding the options menu, controller mappings, clue-connector texts, and more.
There were several routes to achieve 100% on some of the questionings. Now there is just one per suspect.
The rope minigame was too hardcore because of the speed of the fire effect, we tweaked that for a better experience.
There was a possible softlock issue on the clue connector. It's now gone.
We fixed a camera-related bug that sometimes happened when you zoomed in and out which could cause some annoyance.
We managed to add more than 50+ other minor bug fixes and tweaks!

notes.title: 'Behind the Art and Magic of Chicken Police'

items.text: The Artbook DLC is now available to download for free, giving you a glimpse into the making of the game, meeting the team, and seeing old concept art and other early iterations that we've never published anywhere before!
We're thrilled that so many of you are interested in our game, love it, and spread the word, so please don't stop and stay tuned because we'll be back with something astonishing soon.
Stay well, look after each other, drink lots of water, watch out for the animals and don't forget to play more!
The Wild Gentlemen

releases.displayName: The DIRECTOR'S CLUCK EDITION update is coming!

notes.title: The DIRECTOR'S CLUCK EDITION update is coming!

items.text: We are excited to announce that our biggest and boldest update is coming, with wholly new gameplay features, awesome quality of life changes, and tons of bug fixes. (no, no, don't worry, we will not hurt anybody in the Hive! Promise!)
When? Very soon - this summer for sure - so, stay tuned for more!
Take care and keep on being awesome!
The Wild Gentlemen
Hey, folks!
We just fixed a savegame-related issue that may have affected a small fraction of players.
Take care,
The Wild Gentlemen
We worked hard on the second big patch of Chicken Police, in the hope that it will elevate your experience even more! Here's what we did this time:

notes.title: Two new mini-cutscenes after the car chase sequences

items.text: After you win any of the two car chase scenes, a small cutscene will play which connects the mini-game with the next scene.

notes.title: Killed a lot of text errors, typos, voice vs. text differences

items.text: Fixed few-hundred typos and text errors in the script (and we will continue to do this if we find new ones!), also fixed all the known differences between spoken and written dialogues.
There was a wrong text shown in the Bubo's Place page, now it's fixed.
Problems with the cutscenes (black screen) should be gone now.
Fixed the missing localization of Ibn Wessler's 7th personal info entry.
Fixed the issue where the statistic page listed 35 achievements instead of 31.
Missing localizations are fixed.
Fixed the wrong voice-line in one of the dialogues at Mullen's Stand.
Fixed a ton of minor graphical glitches and bugs.
Pausing the game will no longer cause issues in the clue connector minigames, nor affect dialog playback.
Spamming the ESC button at the sculpt in the weekend house can’t "softlock" the game anymore.
We didn't drop the idea of the new save system, but it needs a little more work on our side. Hopefully, it will be coming with the next big update.
Some of you mentioned that it would be great to see new items highlighted in the notebook. We plan to add this feature too.
We also planned several minor convenience features to smoothen the overall experience.
Those who found the car chase scenes to be too difficult, we have a quite handy tip for you: Aim for the wheels!

If you want to get the name of the Bouncer (which is needed for an achievement and for the 100% completion), just speak with him again after he opened the door of the Czar club till you get his name in your notebook.: Thank you to everyone, who supported, played and loved Chicken Police! You are cluckin' awesome!
The Wild Gentlemen
After the successful launch, we immediately started to work on several updates, and now, ladies and gentlemen, our first patch is here, with major bug fixes and a new feature!
Fixed the issue, where some achievements didn't trigger
The clue-connector works as intended on Turkish systems now
Cutscene playback issues some people had should be resolved now
Unsupported controllers/devices should no longer cause issues
Potentially fixed black screen at the start. If the problem still persists for you, please try launching the game in admin mode
Retry Questioning: You now have the opportunity to immediately retry the questioning you just completed. Hit the Retry button, and start over to get the score you always wanted!
Minor changes to some places where players used to get stuck
Fixed localization errors, misspellings, and typos in several languages
The brightness adjustment screen is now available from the main menu

We are planning to enhance the user experience with several new features and fixes like the new save system, which will allow you to load older saves if you want to play a scene again or accidentally missed something which could be important. More details about this, and other planned improvements later.

notes.title: Thank you for all the feedbacks, reports, and reviews; this means a lot to us because we want to make Chicken Police as perfect as possible. :)

items.text: Have a great time playing!
The Wild Gentlemen Team

items.text: Dear Ladies and Gents!
The launch was a blast, and we just can't thank you enough because of your support and love towards Chicken Police!
We also got some reports about bugs and strange design decisions; therefore...

notes.title: we are already working on the first significant patch for the game!

items.text: What can you expect?
We are planning to add some new features, kill the most significant bugs, and also add some progression clarifying fixes too!
We are working day and night to bring this to you as soon as we can. :)
Thank you again for all the reviews, feedback, and the avalanche of love you have given us.
The Wild Gentlemen team
